observations: api-explorer issued ZERO requests in this run (api-runtime-trace mode): all operations below are reconstructed purely from portal-explorer's pre-captured raw/network/*.json + raw/portal/*.md|*.json. No browser opened, no HTTP call made by this agent.

Every Save & Close in this run fires POST /api/artworks/{artworkId}/validate-default-value (always 204, no body captured) BEFORE any circular-dependency check and BEFORE the conditional PUT. Observed identically in 6/6 network files (ACT-01-01-001, ACT-01-02-002, ACT-02-01-001, ACT-02-01-002, ACT-02-02-001, ACT-02-02-002) -> status 204 qualifies as always_present (observed_count=6 >= 3).

PUT /api/artworks/{artworkId} is the single write path for layer.dependency (conditional setting). It was actually sent and returned 200 in 4/6 save attempts (ACT-01-01-001, ACT-01-02-002, ACT-02-01-001, ACT-02-02-001) — all non-cyclic configurations.

In the 2 save attempts that would have produced a circular dependency graph (ACT-02-01-002: 2-step cycle, ACT-02-02-002: 3-step cycle), PUT was NOT sent at all. The block happens client-side, after validate-default-value returns 204 and before any PUT is dispatched. This is directly confirmed by 'status: NOT SENT' recorded in both network capture files plus the verbatim toast message field ui_message_verbatim.

Consequence: the central open question handed off by portal-explorer ('does the server itself reject a cyclic dependency graph on PUT, or only the client?') remains UNANSWERED by this run's evidence, because no capture contains a PUT actually carrying a cyclic payload. Answering it would require sending a PUT with a hand-crafted cyclic payload directly against the API — that is a mutation outside what api-runtime-trace mode is allowed to originate (analysis-only, no self-fired requests). Left as unknown, not resolved.

PUT /api/artworks/{artworkId} response body was never captured in any of the 4 successful sends in this run (network files only record status 200 + request headers). Persistence of the write is instead confirmed indirectly via a separate GraphQL readback (raw/portal/final-state-4087.json), whose body matches the PUT request body verbatim per condition-value-shapes.md §0 step 6 — but that GraphQL call's own HTTP status/headers were not captured in this run's raw/network folder, only its response body content.

layer.dependency shape observed across the successful PUTs confirms 4 distinct value shapes for the 8 eligible source layer types (boolean scalar for toggle; array<number DB id> for additional-option and group-clipart-categories; array<string internal option-id> for addon-charge; array<string display name> for json-list; array<string file path> for font/vector-category/clipart-category). Each shape has observed_count=1 per source type in this run (single 8-condition save) -> per contract §3, kept as OBSERVED_CURRENT, confidence LOW per-shape, NOT generalized into required/enum.
